subtitle.zh: 基于新生数据（DeepSeek 合成）讲解异步加载与字段映射
subtitle.en: Explains asynchronous loading and field mapping using the new-student dataset (synthesized by DeepSeek)

outline.zh: 嵌入理论：AI 合成数据的可信度边界

outline.en: Embedded Theory: The Trustworthiness Boundary of AI-Synthesized Data

search.zh: 你的原案例 本章采用中国石油大学（华东）2025 级新生数据，阐述数据的特性。为了防止数据隐私泄露，数据采用 DeepSeek 大模型生成。数据文件 data/newstudent.csv，含 80 条记录。 嵌入理论：AI 合成数据的可信度边界 数据质量四维度（Wang Strong 1996）：准确性 / 完整性 / 一致性 / 时效性。 DeepSeek 生成数据： ✓ 完整性：字段齐全 △ 准确性：姓名/籍贯是虚构的，不能用作真实人口分析 △ 采样偏差：模型倾向"看起来合理"的分布（如民族偏汉族、籍贯偏大城市） 课堂要点：教学场景使用合成数据没问题，但必须标注"合成数据"，避免学生误以为真实分布。 关键代码 ① 字段名映射 中文列名映射成英文变量名 —— 避免 JS 中带中文 key 引发语法/编码隐患。  // 关键点 ①：字段映射 —— 中文 → 英文 const COLUMN_MAP = { "序号": "id", "姓名": "name", "性别": "gender", "生日": "birthday", "年龄": "age", "班级": "class", }; 关键点解释：为什么不用中文 key？ (1) JS 引擎对中文标识符的容错性差（老浏览器报错）；(2) 后端、JSON、URL 编码都可能引入乱码； (3) IDE 自动补全、搜索、重构工具对中文支持不一致。 最佳实践：CSV 用人可读的中文名，JS 内部统一英文变量。 关键代码 ② 类型转换函数 CSV 加载后所有字段都是字符串，需要把序号/年龄 → Number，生日 → Date 对象。  // 关键点 ②：类型转换函数 —— 用户原文「推荐方式」 function transformRow(d) { return { id: +d["序号"], // 一元 + 把字符串转 Number name: d["姓名"].trim(), // trim() 去掉首尾空白 birthday: new Date(d["生日"]), // 字符串 → Date 对象 age: +d["年龄"], class: d["班级"].trim(), }; } 关键点解释： +d["年龄"] 是一元加运算符，是 JS 里把字符串转数字的最快写法（比 Number() / parseInt() 都短）； new Date(str) 能解析 "2007-08-15" 这类 ISO 格式，但对 "2007/8/15" 兼容性差，要用 d3.timeParse("%Y-%m-%d") 兜底。 坑：没有 trim() 的话，"软件工程1班 " 里的空格会让后续过滤/聚合出错。 关键代码 ③ d3.csv 第二参直接传 row 回调  // 关键点 ③：一行完成加载 + 转换（用户原文「代码示例 1」） const data = await d3.csv("data/newstudent.csv", transformRow); // 验证类型确实转换了： console.log(typeof data[0].age); // "number" console.log(data[0].birthday instanceof Date); // true 关键点解释：d3.csv 是异步函数，必须 await。 第二参的 row 回调会在每一行解析后立即调用——比先 await d3.csv(...) 再 .map(transformRow) 更省内存（边读边转）。 异步加载的意义：不阻塞页面渲染，用户能继续交互。 点击「重新加载」查看 CSV 异步加载、字段映射、类型转换 → 输出转换后表格 + 控制台日志。
search.en: Your Original Case This chapter uses the 2025 new-student data from China University of Petroleum (East China) to illustrate the characteristics of data. To prevent data privacy leaks, the data was generated by the DeepSeek large language model. The data file data/newstudent.csv contains 80 records. Embedded Theory: The Trustworthiness Boundary of AI-Synthesized Data Four Dimensions of Data Quality (Wang Strong 1996): Accuracy / Completeness / Consistency / Timeliness. Data Generated by DeepSeek: ✓ Completeness: all fields present △ Accuracy: names/hometowns are fictional and cannot be used for real demographic analysis △ Sampling bias: the model tends toward 'plausible-looking' distributions (e.g., over-representing the Han ethnicity, favoring large cities for hometowns) Classroom Takeaway: Using synthetic data in teaching is fine, but it must be labeled as 'synthetic data' to prevent students from mistaking it for a real distribution. Key Code ① Field Name Mapping Map Chinese column names to English variable names — to avoid syntax/encoding issues caused by Chinese keys in JS.  // 关键点 ①：字段映射 —— 中文 → 英文 const COLUMN_MAP = { "序号": "id", "姓名": "name", "性别": "gender", "生日": "birthday", "年龄": "age", "班级": "class", }; Key-Point Explanation: Why not use Chinese keys? (1) JS engines have poor tolerance for Chinese identifiers (older browsers throw errors); (2) backends, JSON, and URL encoding may introduce mojibake; (3) IDE autocomplete, search, and refactoring tools have inconsistent support for Chinese. Best Practice: Use human-readable Chinese names in CSV, and use unified English variables internally in JS. Key Code ② Type Conversion Functions After CSV loading, all fields are strings; you need to convert the index/age to Number and the birthday to a Date object.  // 关键点 ②：类型转换函数 —— 用户原文「推荐方式」 function transformRow(d) { return { id: +d["序号"], // 一元 + 把字符串转 Number name: d["姓名"].trim(), // trim() 去掉首尾空白 birthday: new Date(d["生日"]), // 字符串 → Date 对象 age: +d["年龄"], class: d["班级"].trim(), }; } Key-Point Explanation: +d["年龄"] is the unary plus operator, the fastest way in JS to convert a string to a number (shorter than Number() / parseInt()); new Date(str) can parse ISO formats like "2007-08-15", but has poor compatibility with "2007/8/15", so fall back to d3.timeParse("%Y-%m-%d"). Pitfall: Without trim(), the trailing space in "软件工程1班 " will cause later filtering/aggregation to fail. Key Code ③ Pass the row callback directly as the second argument of d3.csv  // 关键点 ③：一行完成加载 + 转换（用户原文「代码示例 1」） const data = await d3.csv("data/newstudent.csv", transformRow); // 验证类型确实转换了： console.log(typeof data[0].age); // "number" console.log(data[0].birthday instanceof Date); // true Key-Point Explanation: d3.csv is an asynchronous function and must be awaited. The row callback in the second argument is invoked immediately after each row is parsed — which saves memory compared to first await d3.csv(...) then .map(transformRow) (transform while reading). Significance of Asynchronous Loading: It does not block page rendering, so the user can keep interacting. Click 'Reload' to see the asynchronous CSV loading, field mapping, and type conversion → output the transformed table + console logs.

subtitle.zh: DIKW 金字塔 —— 数据 → 信息 → 知识 → 智慧
subtitle.en: DIKW Pyramid — Data → Information → Knowledge → Wisdom

outline.zh: 嵌入理论：可视化在 DIKW 中的位置

outline.en: Embedded Theory: The Position of Visualization in the DIKW Model

search.zh: 你的原案例 DI 金 W 金字塔：数据是"原始原始数据"，信息是"组织好的数据"，知识是"模式/规律"，智慧是"判断/战略"。 层原文回答的问题 数据原始、离散的观察结果— 信息经过处理、组织、赋予上下文的数据谁 / 什么 / 何时 / 何地 知识对信息的进一步提炼和理解如何 智慧运用知识做出明智判断和战略决策为什么 / 应该怎么做 嵌入理论：可视化在 DIKW 中的位置 关键洞见：可视化主要把 Data 升到 Information，少数场景能升到 Knowledge，但难以跨越到 Wisdom。 ✓ Data → Information：把表格"翻译"成可读图形（折线图、柱状图、热图） △ Information → Knowledge：模式发现需要统计模型辅助（机器学习） ✕ Knowledge → Wisdom：决策与战略超出可视化能力 Rowley (2007) 批评：DIKW 是过度简化的层次模型，现实中 Data 与 Information 的界限模糊。但作为教学脚手架，仍然最有价值。 关键代码 ① SVG 金字塔路径 金字塔由 4 个 trapezoid 拼接而成 —— D3 path 的 d 属性。  // 关键点 ①：trapezoid 路径 —— 从上到下 4 个点的连线 const topW = 60, botW = 120; const yTop = 20, yBot = 100; const path = ` M ${cx - topW/2} ${yTop} L ${cx + topW/2} ${yTop} L ${cx + botW/2} ${yBot} L ${cx - botW/2} ${yBot} Z `; 关键点解释：SVG path 的 M(moveto)、L(lineto)、Z(close) 是 3 个最常用指令。 模板字符串 `${...}` 可以直接嵌入 JS 变量，比字符串拼接更可读。 实践：复杂形状用 D3 的 d3.symbol()（内置 ★●▲ 等），自己 path 容易出错。 关键代码 ② 交互高亮（hover/click）  // 关键点 ②：选择集绑定事件 —— D3 的事件模型 const g = svg.append("g") .style("cursor", "pointer") .on("mouseover", function() { // 注意 function 而非箭头函数 d3.select(this).select("path") .transition().duration(150) .attr("fill", d3.color(layer.color).brighter(0.5)); }) .on("click", () = showDetail(layer)); 关键点解释：必须用 function() 而非箭头函数—— 因为 D3 回调里要用 this 访问当前元素，箭头函数会捕获外层 this 导致失效。这是 D3 最常见的坑。 transition().duration() 是 D3 内置动画 API，比 jQuery 还简洁。 鼠标悬停金字塔 → 高亮该层 · 点击 → 右侧显示该层定义 / 示例 / 常用可视化
search.en: Your Original Case DIKW Pyramid: Data is 'raw data', Information is 'organized data', Knowledge is 'patterns/regularities', and Wisdom is 'judgment/strategy'. TierTermQuestion Answered DataRaw, discrete observations— InformationData that has been processed, organized, and given contextWho / What / When / Where KnowledgeFurther refinement and understanding of informationHow WisdomApplying knowledge to make wise judgments and strategic decisionsWhy / What to do Embedded Theory: The Position of Visualization in the DIKW Model Key Insight: Visualization mainly lifts Data to Information; in a few scenarios it can reach Knowledge, but it is difficult to cross over to Wisdom. ✓ Data → Information: 'Translate' the table into readable graphics (line chart, bar chart, heatmap) △ Information → Knowledge: Pattern discovery requires statistical models (machine learning) ✕ Knowledge → Wisdom: Decisions and strategy are beyond the capability of visualization Rowley (2007) Critique: DIKW is an oversimplified hierarchical model; in reality the boundary between Data and Information is blurred. But as a teaching scaffold, it remains most valuable. Key Code ① SVG Pyramid Path The pyramid is composed of 4 trapezoids joined together — the d attribute of the D3 path.  // 关键点 ①：trapezoid 路径 —— 从上到下 4 个点的连线 const topW = 60, botW = 120; const yTop = 20, yBot = 100; const path = ` M ${cx - topW/2} ${yTop} L ${cx + topW/2} ${yTop} L ${cx + botW/2} ${yBot} L ${cx - botW/2} ${yBot} Z `; Key-Point Explanation: The SVG path commands M (moveto), L (lineto), and Z (close) are the three most commonly used. Template literals `${...}` can embed JS variables directly, making them more readable than string concatenation. Practice: For complex shapes, use D3's d3.symbol() (which has built-in ★●▲ etc.); hand-writing paths is error-prone. Key Code ② Interactive Highlighting (hover/click)  // 关键点 ②：选择集绑定事件 —— D3 的事件模型 const g = svg.append("g") .style("cursor", "pointer") .on("mouseover", function() { // 注意 function 而非箭头函数 d3.select(this).select("path") .transition().duration(150) .attr("fill", d3.color(layer.color).brighter(0.5)); }) .on("click", () = showDetail(layer)); Key-Point Explanation: You must use function() instead of arrow functions — because D3 callbacks use this to access the current element, and arrow functions capture the outer this, causing it to fail. This is the most common D3 pitfall. transition().duration() is D3's built-in animation API, even more concise than jQuery. Hover over the pyramid → highlight that tier · click → show that tier's definition / examples / common visualizations on the right

subtitle.en: Stevens Measurement Scales × Mackinlay Visual Channel Ranking

outline.zh: 嵌入理论：Stevens 测量尺度（1946）—— 4 类

outline.en: Embedded Theory: Stevens Measurement Scales (1946) — 4 Types

outline.zh: 嵌入理论：Mackinlay 视觉通道排序（1986）

outline.en: Embedded Theory: Mackinlay Visual Channel Ranking (1986)

search.zh: 你的原案例（3 大类） 你的原文给出 3 类属性： 类别型属性：符号或名称，无顺序关系（性别、姓名） 序数型属性：属性值有顺序（学位：本科/硕士/博士） 数值型属性：定量方法（年龄、价格） 嵌入理论：Stevens 测量尺度（1946）—— 4 类 Stevens 把测量尺度分为 4 类，比你的原文更精细： 类别允许的运算典型示例对应你原文 名义 Nominal等价 / 不等价姓名、性别类别型 序数 Ordinal+ 等级、班级序号序数型 区间 Interval+ 加减温度（°C）— 比率 Ratio+ 加减乘除年龄、价格数值型 关键区别：区间尺度没有"真零点"（0°C 不是"没有温度"）；比率尺度有真零点（0 元 = 没有钱）。 嵌入理论：Mackinlay 视觉通道排序（1986） Mackinlay 提出视觉通道分 3 档： 档次通道适合的属性 定量型位置、长度、角度比率 / 区间 顺序型亮度、密度、饱和度序数 定性型色相、形状名义 核心发现：位置是最强的定量通道；色相是最强的定性通道。错配 → 信息丢失。 关键代码 ① 比例尺选型  // 关键点 ①：scale 选型 —— 属性 ↔ 通道的映射 // 比率型数据 → scaleLinear（连续定量） const x = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, 100]).range([0, 800]); // 名义/序数型数据 → scaleBand（离散分类） const x = d3.scaleBand().domain(["软件1班", "软件2班"]).range([0, 800]); 关键点解释：D3 比例尺的 domain() 是数据域（输入），range() 是值域（输出像素）。 选错比例尺是初学者最常犯的错：类别数据用 scaleLinear 会算出没有意义的中间值（如 0.5 班）。 记忆口诀：连续定量用 Linear，离散分类用 Band，序数可用 Point。 关键代码 ② colormap 选型  // 关键点 ②：颜色映射 —— 顺序型 vs 定性型 vs 发散型 // 顺序型（顺序有意义）→ interpolateViridis / interpolateBlues const color = d3.scaleSequential(d3.interpolateViridis); // 定性型（无顺序）→ schemeTableau10 const color = d3.scaleOrdinal().range(d3.schemeTableau10); // 发散型（有中点）→ interpolateRdBu const color = d3.scaleDiverging(d3.interpolateRdBu); 关键点解释：Viridis 是顺序 colormap 的标杆，色觉缺陷（CVD）友好且感知均匀。 常见错误：用彩虹色 interpolateRainbow 编码数值数据 —— 既不 CVD 友好，又有假边界（蓝色→绿色跳跃）。 课堂提问：什么时候用发散型？答：有"中间值"的数据（如正负、温度 vs 平均值）。 4 个 sub-demo：① 类别用色相（✓）② 序数用亮度（✓）③ 数值用位置（✓）④ ✕ 数值用色相（错配，看不出大小关系）
search.en: Your Original Case (3 Categories) Your original text gives 3 types of attributes: Categorical Attribute: a symbol or name with no ordering (gender, name) Ordinal Attribute: attribute values have an order (degree: bachelor's/master's/doctorate) Numerical Attribute: quantitative method (age, price) Embedded Theory: Stevens Measurement Scales (1946) — 4 Types Stevens divides measurement scales into 4 types, finer than your original text: CategoryAllowed OperationsTypical ExampleMaps to Your Original NominalEquivalence / Non-equivalenceName, GenderCategorical Ordinal+ Rank, Class indexOrdinal Interval+ Add/SubtractTemperature (°C)— Ratio+ Add/Subtract/Multiply/DivideAge, PriceNumerical Key Difference: The interval scale has no 'true zero point' (0°C is not 'no temperature'); the ratio scale has a true zero (0 yuan = no money). Embedded Theory: Mackinlay Visual Channel Ranking (1986) Mackinlay proposes dividing visual channels into 3 tiers: TierChannelSuitable Attribute QuantitativePosition, Length, AngleRatio / Interval OrderedBrightness, Density, SaturationOrdinal QualitativeHue, ShapeNominal Core Finding: Position is the strongest quantitative channel; hue is the strongest qualitative channel. Mismatch → information loss. Key Code ① Scale Selection  // 关键点 ①：scale 选型 —— 属性 ↔ 通道的映射 // 比率型数据 → scaleLinear（连续定量） const x = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, 100]).range([0, 800]); // 名义/序数型数据 → scaleBand（离散分类） const x = d3.scaleBand().domain(["软件1班", "软件2班"]).range([0, 800]); Key-Point Explanation: A D3 scale's domain() is the data domain (input) and range() is the value range (output pixels). Choosing the wrong scale is the most common beginner mistake: using scaleLinear for categorical data produces meaningless intermediate values (e.g., class 0.5). Memory Aid: Use Linear for continuous quantitative, Band for discrete categorical, and Point for ordinal. Key Code ② Colormap Selection  // 关键点 ②：颜色映射 —— 顺序型 vs 定性型 vs 发散型 // 顺序型（顺序有意义）→ interpolateViridis / interpolateBlues const color = d3.scaleSequential(d3.interpolateViridis); // 定性型（无顺序）→ schemeTableau10 const color = d3.scaleOrdinal().range(d3.schemeTableau10); // 发散型（有中点）→ interpolateRdBu const color = d3.scaleDiverging(d3.interpolateRdBu); Key-Point Explanation: Viridis is the benchmark sequential colormap — color-vision-deficiency (CVD) friendly and perceptually uniform. Common Mistake: Using the rainbow colormap interpolateRainbow to encode numerical data — it is neither CVD-friendly nor free of false boundaries (blue→green jumps). Class Question: When to use a diverging colormap? Answer: Data that has a 'middle value' (e.g., positive/negative, temperature vs. average). 4 sub-demos: ① Categorical uses hue (✓) ② Ordinal uses brightness (✓) ③ Numerical uses position (✓) ④ ✕ Numerical uses hue (mismatch — cannot tell magnitude)

subtitle.zh: D3 8 个函数式数组操作
subtitle.en: D3's 8 Functional Array Operations

outline.zh: 你的原案例（8 个函数）
嵌入理论：函数式数据流

search.zh: 你的原案例（8 个函数） 你的原文列出 D3 提供的 8 个常见函数： map(iterable, mapper) —— 类似 Array.map reduce(iterable, reducer, init) —— 类似 Array.reduce cross(...iterables, reducer) —— 笛卡尔积 merge(iterables) —— 合并为扁平数组 pairs(iterable, reducer) —— 相邻元素对 transpose(matrix) —— 矩阵转置 zip(...arrays) —— 按位合并 filter(iterable, test) —— 类似 Array.filter 嵌入理论：函数式数据流 这 8 个函数的共同特点： ✓ 不可变（immutable）：输入不变，返回新数组 ✓ 纯函数：相同输入 → 相同输出，无副作用 ✓ 可链式：返回值是数组，可以接下一层变换 为什么函数式？ 可推理：每层变换独立可测 可并行：map/reduce/filter 天然支持并行化 可缓存：纯函数的输出可以记忆化 数据立方体（OLAP）雏形：transpose 做宽/长格式转换，group + rollup 做切片/切块/钻取 —— 这正是 BI 系统的核心。 关键代码 ① map / reduce 的链式组合  // 关键点 ①：函数式数据流 —— map 后接 filter 再 reduce const avgAge = students .filter(s = s.gender === "男") // ① 过滤男生 .map(s = s.age) // ② 提取年龄 .reduce((sum, a) = sum + a, 0) // ③ 合计 / students.filter(s = s.gender === "男").length; // ④ 求平均 关键点解释：链式调用的每一步返回新数组，不会修改原数组。 与命令式对比：命令式需要 4 个临时变量 + 一个 for 循环，函数式一行搞定。 性能权衡：每次 map/filter 都会创建新数组，对超大数组有性能损耗（百万级以上才显著）。 关键代码 ② cross（笛卡尔积）  // 关键点 ②：cross —— 笛卡尔积，用于两两组合 const genders = ["男", "女"]; const majors = ["软件工程", "数据科学"]; const combos = d3.cross(genders, majors); // → [["男","软件工程"], ["男","数据科学"], ["女","软件工程"], ["女","数据科学"]] 关键点解释：笛卡尔积常用在"两两组合"分析（如性别 × 专业的人数统计）。 第二参 reducer 可选，用来"合并"两个元素。 扩展：3 个数组的笛卡尔积是 8 种，n 个数组的笛卡尔积是乘积大小。 关键代码 ③ group / rollup（聚合）  // 关键点 ③：group 与 rollup —— 层次聚合 // group 返回 Map（保留所有元素） const byClass = d3.group(students, s = s.class); // rollup 返回 Map（每个 key 只保留聚合值） const countByClass = d3.rollup( students, v = v.length, s = s.class ); 关键点解释：group vs rollup 是"分组保留"vs"分组聚合"的区别。 rollup 第二参是 reducer 函数（这里取长度），后续章节 doc-02 会详细用 rollup 做树形数据。 下拉切换 8 个函数，右侧显示输入/输出对照 + 真实场景（新生数据）
search.en: Your Original Case (8 Functions) Your original text lists 8 common functions provided by D3: map(iterable, mapper) — similar to Array.map reduce(iterable, reducer, init) — similar to Array.reduce cross(...iterables, reducer) — Cartesian product merge(iterables) — merge into a flat array pairs(iterable, reducer) — adjacent element pairs transpose(matrix) — matrix transpose zip(...arrays) — combine by position filter(iterable, test) — similar to Array.filter Embedded Theory: Functional Data Flow Common characteristics of these 8 functions: ✓ Immutable: input unchanged, returns a new array ✓ Pure function: same input → same output, no side effects ✓ Chainable: returns an array, can be followed by the next transformation Why Functional? Can be reasoned about: each transformation layer is independent and testable Parallelizable: map/reduce/filter are naturally parallelizable Cacheable: outputs of pure functions can be memoized The Prototype of the Data Cube (OLAP): transpose performs wide/long format conversion, and group + rollup performs slicing/dicing/drilling — this is exactly the core of BI systems. Key Code ① Chained Composition of map / reduce  // 关键点 ①：函数式数据流 —— map 后接 filter 再 reduce const avgAge = students .filter(s = s.gender === "男") // ① 过滤男生 .map(s = s.age) // ② 提取年龄 .reduce((sum, a) = sum + a, 0) // ③ 合计 / students.filter(s = s.gender === "男").length; // ④ 求平均 Key-Point Explanation: Each step of the chained call returns a new array and does not modify the original array. Compared with Imperative: The imperative style needs 4 temporary variables + a for loop, while the functional style does it in one line. Performance Trade-off: Each map/filter creates a new array, which incurs a performance cost for very large arrays (only significant above the million level). Key Code ② cross (Cartesian Product)  // 关键点 ②：cross —— 笛卡尔积，用于两两组合 const genders = ["男", "女"]; const majors = ["软件工程", "数据科学"]; const combos = d3.cross(genders, majors); // → [["男","软件工程"], ["男","数据科学"], ["女","软件工程"], ["女","数据科学"]] Key-Point Explanation: The Cartesian product is commonly used in 'pairwise combination' analysis (e.g., counting students by gender × major). The second reducer argument is optional and is used to 'combine' the two elements. Extension: The Cartesian product of 3 arrays yields 8 combinations; for n arrays it is the product of their sizes. Key Code ③ group / rollup (Aggregation)  // 关键点 ③：group 与 rollup —— 层次聚合 // group 返回 Map（保留所有元素） const byClass = d3.group(students, s = s.class); // rollup 返回 Map（每个 key 只保留聚合值） const countByClass = d3.rollup( students, v = v.length, s = s.class ); Key-Point Explanation: group vs rollup is the difference between 'keep groups' and 'aggregate groups'. The second argument of rollup is a reducer function (here it takes the length); in later chapter doc-02, rollup will be used in detail for tree-structured data. Use the dropdown to switch among the 8 functions; the right side shows input/output comparison + a real scenario (new-student data)

search.zh: 你的原案例（6 个选择器方法） 你的原文梳理了 6 个选择器方法： 方法返回 d3.select单个元素 d3.selectAll多个元素的 selection selection.select每个选中元素的后代中第一个 selection.selectAll后代中所有 selection.selectChild直接子元素第一个 selection.selectChildren所有直接子元素 嵌入理论：Data-Join 三态模型（Mike Bostock） D3 的核心是 Data-Join：把数据数组"绑定"到 DOM 元素上。 当数据变化时： 新数据 旧数据：多出来的进入 enter（要 append） 新数据 = 旧数据：原有元素进入 update（要改属性） 新数据 旧数据：多余的元素进入 exit（要 remove） Data-Join vs 命令式 DOM 命令式声明式（Data-Join） createElement 后逐个 append.data(arr).join(...) 一行 全量重绘增量更新（性能好） 元素身份丢失key 函数保留稳定身份（动画自然） 与数据流脱节与函数式数据流天然契合 关键代码 ① .join(enter, update, exit) 三态  // 关键点 ①：D3 v5+ 的 join() API —— 优雅处理三态 const circles = svg.selectAll("circle") .data(currentData) .join( enter = enter.append("circle").attr("fill", "green"), // enter update = update.attr("fill", "cyan"), // update exit = exit.remove() // exit ); 关键点解释：join 的三个回调分别在 enter / update / exit 阶段被调用。 这种"声明式三态"比 v3 的 enter().append() + exit().remove() 写法更简洁，逻辑更不易出错。 类比：React 的 diff + patch —— 同样思想，但 React 帮你做了，D3 让你自己写变换函数。 关键代码 ② key 函数保身份  // 关键点 ②：key 函数 —— 元素身份的稳定器 // ✕ 不带 key：数据顺序变化 → 所有元素都"update"，过渡动画错乱 svg.selectAll("circle").data(newData); // ✓ 带 key：用唯一字段绑定身份，元素"知道自己是哪个" svg.selectAll("circle").data(newData, d = d.id); // 同样的逻辑用 React 描述：key={item.id} 关键点解释：key 函数是 D3 动画的灵魂。 没有 key 时，D3 按 index 绑定身份：数据重排会导致"所有元素都换位置"。 带 key 后，每个 circle 知道自己的 id 是什么，重排时只是 cx 变化，过渡动画自然。 类比：与 React 的 key={item.id} 完全相同的思想。 关键代码 ③ d3.select vs d3.selectAll  // 关键点 ③：选择器的核心区别 // select：返回 1 个元素（第一个匹配）；数据绑定只对这一个元素 const title = d3.select("#title"); // selectAll：返回多个元素；数据绑定按顺序一一对应 const bars = d3.selectAll(".bar").data(values); 关键点解释：select 用于"操作单个元素"，selectAll 用于"批量绑定数据"。 常见错误：用 selectAll(".bar") 给一个数组绑定数据时，元素数量与数据数量必须匹配，否则会"留空"或"溢出"。 最佳实践：先用 selectAll 创建占位元素（可能为空），再 .data().join(...)。 点击按钮触发 enter (绿) / update (蓝) / exit (红)，观察三态切换
search.en: Your Original Case (6 Selector Methods) Your original text outlines 6 selector methods: MethodReturns d3.selectsingle element d3.selectAllselection of multiple elements selection.selectthe first descendant of each selected element selection.selectAllall descendants selection.selectChildthe first direct child element selection.selectChildrenall direct child elements Embedded Theory: The Data-Join Three-State Model (Mike Bostock) The core of D3 is Data-Join: 'binding' a data array to DOM elements. When the data changes: New data old data: the extras enter enter (need to append) New data = old data: the existing elements enter update (need attribute changes) New data old data: the surplus elements enter exit (need to remove) Data-Join vs Imperative DOM ImperativeDeclarative (Data-Join) createElement then append one by one.data(arr).join(...) in one line full re-renderincremental update (better performance) element identity lostkey function preserves stable identity (natural animation) disconnected from the data flownaturally fits the functional data flow Key Code ① .join(enter, update, exit) Three States  // 关键点 ①：D3 v5+ 的 join() API —— 优雅处理三态 const circles = svg.selectAll("circle") .data(currentData) .join( enter = enter.append("circle").attr("fill", "green"), // enter update = update.attr("fill", "cyan"), // update exit = exit.remove() // exit ); Key-Point Explanation: The three callbacks of join are invoked in the enter / update / exit phases respectively. This 'declarative three-state' pattern is more concise than the v3 enter().append() + exit().remove() style, and less error-prone. Analogy: React's diff + patch — the same idea, but React does it for you, while D3 lets you write the transformation functions yourself. Key Code ② key Function Preserves Identity  // 关键点 ②：key 函数 —— 元素身份的稳定器 // ✕ 不带 key：数据顺序变化 → 所有元素都"update"，过渡动画错乱 svg.selectAll("circle").data(newData); // ✓ 带 key：用唯一字段绑定身份，元素"知道自己是哪个" svg.selectAll("circle").data(newData, d = d.id); // 同样的逻辑用 React 描述：key={item.id} Key-Point Explanation: The key function is the soul of D3 animation. Without a key, D3 binds identity by index: reordering data causes 'all elements to move'. With a key, each circle knows its id, and on reorder only cx changes, so the transition animation is natural. Analogy: Exactly the same idea as React's key={item.id}. Key Code ③ d3.select vs d3.selectAll  // 关键点 ③：选择器的核心区别 // select：返回 1 个元素（第一个匹配）；数据绑定只对这一个元素 const title = d3.select("#title"); // selectAll：返回多个元素；数据绑定按顺序一一对应 const bars = d3.selectAll(".bar").data(values); Key-Point Explanation: select is used to 'operate on a single element', and selectAll is used to 'bind data in bulk'. Common Mistake: When using selectAll(".bar") to bind data to an array, the number of elements must match the number of data items, otherwise it will 'leave gaps' or 'overflow'. Best Practice: First use selectAll to create placeholder elements (possibly empty), then .data().join(...). Click the button to trigger enter (green) / update (blue) / exit (red), and observe the three-state switching

search.zh: 你的原案例 3 个可视化流程模型：① 参考 Card 1999 模型绘制流程图（Box Flowcharts）→ ② Mackinlay 自动化准则 → ③ van Wijk 模型（含交互反馈）。 原始图片是你的概念图。本节课用 D3 重画这张概念图，每个节点点击后能展开细节。 嵌入理论：可视化流程的三个经典模型 模型作者 / 年份核心思想 Card 数据流模型 Card, Mackinlay Shneiderman, 1999 原始数据 → 数据表 → 视觉结构 → 视图（嵌套变换 D→T→V→C/L/S） Mackinlay 自动化准则 Mackinlay 1986 对每种数据类型，自动选「量化准确性最高」的视觉通道（如：数值→位置、类别→色调） van Wijk 反馈模型 van Wijk 2005 View ⇆ Filter ⇆ Param ⇆ Other Views —— 强调交互反馈循环 核心教学要点：三个模型描述同一件事的不同侧面—— Card 给"管道"，Mackinlay 给"自动决策"，van Wijk 给"反馈环"。 三者是叠加关系，不是冲突关系。 Card 模型：告诉你"transform 之后该 mapping，mapping 之后该 view" Mackinlay：告诉你"mapping 这一步怎么自动决策" van Wijk：告诉你"view 之后还要把用户操作 feed 回去" 关键代码 ① SVG 流程图节点 + 箭头 5 个 step 节点横向排列，相邻节点之间用 SVG marker 画的箭头连接。  // 1. 用 defs + marker 定义箭头 svg.append("defs").append("marker") .attr("id", "arrowhead") .attr("viewBox", "0 -5 10 10") .attr("refX", 8) // 箭头位置校准 .attr("markerWidth", 6) .attr("orient", "auto") // 跟随线方向旋转 .append("path").attr("d", "M0,-5L10,0L0,5").attr("fill", "#94a3b8");  // 2. 用 marker-end 引用箭头（重要） svg.append("line") .attr("marker-end", "url(#arrowhead)") .attr("x1", x1).attr("y1", y).attr("x2", x2).attr("y2", y);  // 3. 节点 ↔ 数据 绑定：d3.data + click 事件 svg.selectAll(".node").data(nodes) .join("g") .on("click", (event, d) = { //  关键：classed 是 D3 状态管理核心 API svg.selectAll(".node").classed("selected", n = n.id === d.id); document.getElementById("d-4-1-detail").innerHTML = d.detail; }); 关键点解释： marker-end="url(#arrowhead)" 是 SVG 引用的方式 —— 把 defs 里定义的形状"嵌入"到线段末端； classed("selected", predicate) 接收布尔函数，一次性切换所有节点的"selected"状态，避免自己写 forEach。 ▶ 交互流程图演示  点击任一节点查看在 Card / Mackinlay / van Wijk 三个模型中的对应
search.en: Your Original Case 3 visualization pipeline models: ① Reference the Card 1999 model for box flowcharts ② Mackinlay's automation principles ③ van Wijk's model (with interaction feedback). The original image is your concept map. This lesson uses D3 to redraw this concept map every node expands details when clicked. Embedded Theory: Three Classic Models of the Visualization Pipeline ModelAuthor / YearCore Idea Card Data Flow Model Card, Mackinlay Shneiderman, 1999 Raw data data table visual structure view (nested transformations D T V C/L/S) Mackinlay's Automation Principles Mackinlay, 1986 For each data type, automatically pick the visual channel with the highest quantitative accuracy (e.g., quantitative position, categorical hue) van Wijk Feedback Model van Wijk, 2005 View Filter Param Other Views emphasizing the interaction feedback loop Core teaching points: the three models describe different facets of the same thing Card gives you the pipeline, Mackinlay gives you automated decisions, and van Wijk gives you the feedback loop. They layer on top of each other rather than conflict. Card model: tells you after transform comes mapping, after mapping comes view Mackinlay: tells you how to automate the mapping step van Wijk: tells you after view, you still need to feed user actions back Key Code SVG Flowchart Nodes + Arrows 5 step nodes arranged horizontally, connected by SVG-marker-drawn arrows between adjacent nodes.  // 1. 用 defs + marker 定义箭头 svg.append("defs").append("marker") .attr("id", "arrowhead") .attr("viewBox", "0 -5 10 10") .attr("refX", 8) // 箭头位置校准 .attr("markerWidth", 6) .attr("orient", "auto") // 跟随线方向旋转 .append("path").attr("d", "M0,-5L10,0L0,5").attr("fill", "#94a3b8");  // 2. 用 marker-end 引用箭头（重要） svg.append("line") .attr("marker-end", "url(#arrowhead)") .attr("x1", x1).attr("y1", y).attr("x2", x2).attr("y2", y);  // 3. 节点 ↔ 数据 绑定：d3.data + click 事件 svg.selectAll(".node").data(nodes) .join("g") .on("click", (event, d) = { //  关键：classed 是 D3 状态管理核心 API svg.selectAll(".node").classed("selected", n = n.id === d.id); document.getElementById("d-4-1-detail").innerHTML = d.detail; }); Key explanation: marker-end="url(#arrowhead)" is SVG's referencing mechanism it embeds a shape defined inside defs at the line's end; classed("selected", predicate) takes a boolean function and toggles the selected state of every node in one call, so you avoid writing forEach yourself. search.zh: 本节在流程中的位置：数据变换（Data Transformation） Card 1999 数据流模型把可视化拆成四段： 原始数据 → (变换) → 数据表 → (映射) → 视觉结构 → (渲染) → 视图。 本节讲的 2.2，就是第一段箭头 「原始数据 → 数据表」—— 这正是 数据变换（Data Transformation）。 你的原案例 用新生数据按 "专业 / 班级" 做 rollup 分桶聚合。 你演示的核心是 d3.rollup 的链式调用 —— 一个函数完成多维度分组。 理论补丁：数据变换的四大操作（Card 1999 D 层） 从「原始数据」到「数据表」，D 层做四类操作（注意：原文 4.2 节只讲了"分桶聚合"，这里把它放到完整的数据变换框架里）： 操作做什么D3 实现 清洗 / 过滤 (clean / filter)去缺失、去异常、筛选满足条件的行.filter()、d3.csv(row) 回调 聚合 / 汇总 (aggregate)按 key 分组，把同组归约为一个值d3.rollup()、d3.group() 连接 / 关联 (join)按键把两张表拼起来（如把学生表 join 班级表）d3.map + 手动索引 派生 / 衍生 (derive)由已有列算出新列（如从"班级"切出"专业"）row 回调里算一个新字段 本节演示的 rollup 聚合，属于"聚合"这一行。但读懂这张表，你才知道 数据变换是整个可视化流水线的"第一公里" —— 数据表没整理好，后面映射/渲染全都白搭。 嵌入理论：函数式聚合与 OLAP 切片 d3.rollup 是"按 key 分桶、再 reduce 一次"的函数式组合： const result = d3.rollup( data, // 输入数组 v = v.length, // reducer d = d.major, // key1（外层） d = d.class // key2（内层，可选） ); 它返回 Map（不是数组、不是对象），所以： 遍历用 for ([k, v] of m) 或 m.entries() 嵌套 rollup 出嵌套 Map 与 d3.group 的差别：rollup 把组内数据归约成一个值，group 保留原数组 理论补丁：OLAP 切片/切块/钻取 1993 年 Codd 提出 OLAP 12 条准则，其中 3 个核心操作用 rollup 就能模拟： 切片 (Slice)：固定一维度（如只看 2025 级）→ 等价于 .filter() 后 rollup 切块 (Dice)：按两个维度分组 → 等价于双 key rollup 钻取 (Drill)：层层下钻 → 等价于嵌套 rollup + 递归展开 教学要点：可视化系统的"下钻交互"通常背后就是 rollup + hierarchy 的组合。本节课演示 d3.rollup 的多层级能力。 关键代码 ① 双层 rollup 两层 key：外层 = 专业，内层 = 班级，reducer = 计数。  // 双层 rollup：返回嵌套 Map，外层 key=专业，内层 key=班级 const nested = d3.rollup( students, v = v.length, // 每组聚合为单一值（这里是 count） d = d.major, // 外层 key d = d.class // 内层 key（rest 参数，可继续加） ); // 遍历嵌套 Map： for (const [major, inner] of nested) { for (const [cls, count] of inner) { console.log(major, cls, count); } } 关键点解释： d3.rollup 的 key 参数是rest 参数（...keys），所以传 1 个 → 单层 Map，传 2 个 → 嵌套 Map，传 3 个 → 3 层嵌套。 这就是 OLAP 的"维度组合"。 关键代码 ② 用正则提取专业 CSV 里只有"班级"字段（"软件工程1班"），需要用正则切出"专业"和"班级序号"。  // d3.csv 第二参 row 回调里逐行 transform const data = await d3.csv("./data/newstudent.csv", d = { const cls = d["班级"].trim(); const m = cls.match(/^(.+?)(\d+班)$/); // 中间非贪婪 + 末尾"数字+班" return { id: +d["序号"], name: d["姓名"].trim(), class: cls, major: m ? m[1] : cls, // "软件工程1班" → "软件工程" }; }); 关键点解释： 正则 /^(.+?)(\d+班)$/ 的 .+? 是非贪婪匹配，会让中间尽可能短、末尾留给 \d+班。 没这个非贪婪：.+ 会把整串都匹配走，剩下空，m[1] 就是 undefined。 这类正则坑学生常踩，必须掌握。 ▶ d3.rollup 多层聚合演示
search.en: Where This Sits: Data Transformation The Card 1999 data-flow model splits visualization into four stages: raw data (transform) data table (map) visual structure (render) view. Section 2.2 is the first arrow, raw data data table i.e. Data Transformation. Your Original Case Use the freshman data to do rollup bucketed aggregation by major / class . The core of your demo is d3.rollup's chained calls one function that performs multi-dimensional grouping. Theory Patch: Four Operations of Data Transformation (Card s D layer) Going from raw data to a data table, the D layer performs four kinds of operations: OperationWhat it doesD3 implementation Clean / filterRemove missing/outliers; keep rows matching a condition.filter(), d3.csv(row) callback AggregateGroup by key, reduce each group to a single valued3.rollup(), d3.group() JoinCombine two tables by key (e.g., student table joined to class table)d3.map + manual indexing DeriveCompute a new column from existing ones (e.g., extract major from class )compute a new field in the row callback The rollup aggregation demonstrated here belongs to the aggregate row. But reading this table, you realize data transformation is the first kilometer of the whole pipeline if the data table isn't clean, all the mapping and rendering downstream is wasted. Embedded Theory: Functional Aggregation and OLAP Slicing d3.rollup is a functional composition of bucket by key, then reduce once : const result = d3.rollup( data, // 输入数组 v = v.length, // reducer d = d.major, // key1（外层） d = d.class // key2（内层，可选） ); It returns a Map (not an array, not an object), so: Iterate using for ([k, v] of m) or m.entries() Nested rollup produces a nested Map Difference from d3.group: rollup reduces the in-group data to a single value, while group preserves the original array Theory Patch: OLAP Slice / Dice / Drill In 1993 Codd proposed 12 OLAP rules; three of their core operations can be simulated with rollup: Slice: fix one dimension (e.g., only look at the 2025 cohort) equivalent to .filter() then rollup Dice: group by two dimensions equivalent to a double-key rollup Drill: drill down level by level equivalent to nested rollup + recursive expansion Classroom Takeaway: a visualization system's drill-down interaction is typically backed by a combination of rollup + hierarchy. This lesson demonstrates d3.rollup's multi-level capability. Key Code Double-layer Rollup Two key layers: outer = major, inner = class, reducer = count.  // 双层 rollup：返回嵌套 Map，外层 key=专业，内层 key=班级 const nested = d3.rollup( students, v = v.length, // 每组聚合为单一值（这里是 count） d = d.major, // 外层 key d = d.class // 内层 key（rest 参数，可继续加） ); // 遍历嵌套 Map： for (const [major, inner] of nested) { for (const [cls, count] of inner) { console.log(major, cls, count); } } Key explanation: The key parameter of d3.rollup is a rest parameter (...keys), so passing 1 single-layer Map, 2 nested Map, 3 3-layer nesting. This is OLAP's dimension combination. Key Code Extract the Major via Regex The CSV only has a class field (e.g., Software Engineering Class 1 ), so a regex is needed to split out the major and the class number.  // d3.csv 第二参 row 回调里逐行 transform const data = await d3.csv("./data/newstudent.csv", d = { const cls = d["班级"].trim(); const m = cls.match(/^(.+?)(\d+班)$/); // 中间非贪婪 + 末尾"数字+班" return { id: +d["序号"], name: d["姓名"].trim(), class: cls, major: m ? m[1] : cls, // "软件工程1班" → "软件工程" }; }); Key explanation: In the regex /^(.+?)(\d+班)$/, the .+? is non-greedy matching it keeps the middle as short as possible and leaves the tail for \d+班. Without non-greedy: .+ would consume the whole string, leaving nothing, and m[1] would be undefined. This is a regex pitfall students frequently step on; you must master it. d3.rollup Multi-level Aggregation Demo

search.zh: 本节在流程中的位置：视觉映射（Visual Mapping） 接上一节 2.2 数据变换，我们有了"数据表"。本节的 2.3 是第二段箭头 「数据表 → 视觉结构」 —— 也就是 视觉映射（Visual Mapping）。 它回答一个核心问题：数据里每个属性，该用哪个视觉通道来表达？ 你的原案例 你的 4.2 节提到"树形结构可视化"。这节展开树布局算法原理 —— 拿到层级数据后，怎么把节点摆到屏幕上不打架？ 理论核心：什么是视觉通道？Mackinlay 的排名 视觉通道（visual channel）是指"把数据编码到视觉元素上"的载体： 位置、长度、面积、角度、颜色、形状、纹理…… Mackinlay 1986 给出经典排名：对不同数据类型，各通道的量化精确度不一样。 这就是下面这张图。 图 1 · Mackinlay 1986 通道排名：对 Quantitative（定量）/ Ordinal（有序）/ Nominal（名义）三类数据，各通道的量化精确度排序。位置（Position）永远最准。 位置（Position）：三种数据类型都是第一 —— 人眼对位置最敏感 定量数据：长度 → 角度 → 斜率 → 面积（长条形图比面积图准） 名义数据：位置 → 色调（hue）→ 纹理 → 连接 → 形状 理论核心：图元（marks）与视觉通道的构成 视觉结构由 图元（mark）打底：点（Point）、线（Line）、面（Area）。 然后通过 通道把这些图元"做记号"：位置、颜色、形状、倾斜、大小。 下面两张图拆开讲。 图 2 · 图元（marks）三族：点（Points）、线（Lines）、面（Areas）。图元决定"一份数据长什么样"，是视觉结构的骨架。 图 3 · 常用视觉通道族：位置（Position，含水平/垂直/两者）、颜色（Color）、形状（Shape）、倾斜（Tilt）、大小（Size，含长度/面积/体积）。 理论核心：两类通道 —— 幅度 vs 标识 按"能不能表达量的多少"，通道分两类： 幅度通道（Magnitude）表达有序/定量属性；标识通道（Identity）表达类别属性。 选错类别 = 误导读者。 图 4 · 幅度通道（Magnitude Channels）：表达"有序属性"。按精确度排序 —— 共用尺度位置最准，长度/倾斜/面积次之，颜色亮度、饱和度和体积最弱（都标 "Same" 即排序有歧义）。 图 5 · 标识通道（Identity Channels）：表达"类别属性" —— 空间区域、色调（hue）、运动（motion）、形状（shape）。它们能区分"不同类"，但分不出"谁多谁少"。 本节案例的落点：树布局（Reingold-Tilford）本质上就是一种视觉映射 —— 用 位置通道 把层级关系编码成"父在上、子在下的树"。下面讲它的算法。 嵌入理论：Reingold-Tilford 算法（d3.tree 的核心） Reingold Tilford 1981 年提出的算法，至今仍是 d3.tree() 的实现核心。核心思路： 第一遍（自底向上）：对每个父节点，计算其左右子树"占用多少横向空间" 第二遍（自顶向下）：给每个节点分配绝对 x 坐标（保证兄弟节点紧贴父节点中线且不重叠） 第三遍：处理"线程"（threads）—— 修复子节点跨父中线时的对齐 复杂度的处理： O(n) 时间 —— 比简单的"递归平分"要快 节点的左右子树宽度的最小值 = 至少容纳所有子节点的水平空间 不同布局策略选型：d3.tree（左右）、d3.cluster（左右紧贴）、d3.treemap（面积） 理论补丁：d3-hierarchy 模块全家桶 hierarchy(data)：把任意嵌套 data 转成 hierarchy 结构（每个节点加 parent/children/depth） tree().size([h, w])：reingold-tilford 算法，左右布局 cluster().size([h, w])：所有叶子节点对齐到同一深度 treemap().tile(...)：面积（slice-and-dice / squarified / resquarify 算法） pack().radius(d = ...)：圆环打包（circle packing） partition().size([h, w])：icicle / sunburst 布局 关键代码 ① hierarchy + tree 三步走 这是 d3-hierarchy 的标准模式：先建 hierarchy、再求 tree layout、最后画 links + nodes。  // 1. hierarchy：从嵌套 JSON → 计算每个节点的 parent/children/depth const root = d3.hierarchy(rootData);  // 2. tree layout：给每个节点算 x/y 坐标 const treeLayout = d3.tree().size([360, 720]); const treeData = treeLayout(root);  // 3. 画 links：父-子连线（Reingold-Tilford 算法结果就在这里） g.selectAll(".link").data(treeData.links()).join("path") .attr("d", d3.linkHorizontal().x(d = d.y).y(d = d.x));  // 4. 画 nodes：圆 + 文字 const ng = g.selectAll(".node").data(treeData.descendants()).join("g") .attr("transform", d = `translate(${d.y}, ${d.x})`); ng.append("circle").attr("r", 5); ng.append("text") .attr("text-anchor", d = d.children ? "end" : "start") .attr("x", d = d.children ? -8 : 8) .text(d = d.data.name); 关键点解释： treeData.x 是深度方向（默认垂直），treeData.y 是水平方向（同一深度的不同节点）。 所以 linkHorizontal 用 x=d.y, y=d.x —— 横线方向走 y，垂直方向走 x。 这种"x 轴走 y、y 轴走 x"的 swap 是横向树特有的，记住。 关键代码 ② separation 控制父子间距 separation 接收函数，返回 [node, parent] 之间的"间隔倍数"。 const treeLayout = d3.tree() .size([360, 720]) .separation((a, b) = (a.parent === b.parent ? 1 : 2)); // ↑ 兄弟节点紧贴 ↑ 非兄弟至少隔 2 倍 关键点解释： separation 默认值 (a, b) = a.parent === b.parent ? 1 : 2。 改成 0.5 → 全部挤一起；改成 2.0 → 树变宽。 Demo 里有个 slider 让你实时调看效果。 ▶ 树布局演示  切换聚合层次（专业→班级 / 性别→专业→班级 等），滑动 slider 调 separation 看效果 · 这就是用「位置通道」做视觉映射
search.en: Where This Sits: Visual Mapping Following the 2.2 data transformation, we now have a data table. Section 2.3 is the second arrow, data table visual structure i.e. Visual Mapping. It answers one core question: for each data attribute, which visual channel should express it? Your Original Case Your Section 4.2 mentioned tree-structure visualization. This lesson expands on the tree layout algorithm once you have hierarchical data, how do you place nodes on screen without overlap? Theory Core: What Is a Visual Channel? Mackinlay's Ranking A visual channel is the carrier that encodes data onto a visual element : position, length, area, angle, color, shape, texture Mackinlay (1986) gave the classic ranking: for different data types, the quantitative accuracy of each channel differs. That is the figure below. Figure 1 Mackinlay (1986) channel ranking: for Quantitative / Ordinal / Nominal data, the quantitative-accuracy ordering of each channel. Position is always the most accurate. Position: ranks #1 for all three types the eye is most sensitive to position Quantitative data: length angle slope area (bar charts beat area charts) Nominal data: position hue texture connection shape Theory Core: Marks and the Composition of Visual Channels The visual structure is built on marks: Point, Line, Area. These marks are then marked up through channels: position, color, shape, tilt, size. The next two figures break this apart. Figure 2 Three families of marks: Points, Lines, Areas. Marks determine what a datum looks like the skeleton of the visual structure. Figure 3 Common visual-channel families: Position (horizontal / vertical / both), Color, Shape, Tilt, Size (length / area / volume). Theory Core: Two Channel Classes Magnitude vs Identity By whether it can express magnitude, channels split into two classes: Magnitude channels express ordered / quantitative attributes; Identity channels express categorical attributes. Picking the wrong class misleads readers. Figure 4 Magnitude Channels: express ordered attributes. Ordered by accuracy position on a common scale is best; length / tilt / area next; color luminance, saturation, and volume are weakest (all marked Same ambiguous ordering). Figure 5 Identity Channels: express categorical attributes spatial region, hue, motion, shape. They distinguish different categories but cannot rank more vs less. Where this lesson lands: tree layout (Reingold-Tilford) is essentially a visual mapping it uses the position channel to encode hierarchy as parent above, children below. The algorithm follows. Embedded Theory: The Reingold-Tilford Algorithm (the core of d3.tree) The algorithm proposed by Reingold Tilford in 1981 is still the implementation core of d3.tree(). Core idea: First pass (bottom-up): for each parent node, compute how much horizontal space its left and right subtrees occupy Second pass (top-down): assign every node an absolute x-coordinate (so siblings hug the parent's centerline without overlapping) Third pass: handle threads fix the alignment when children cross the parent's centerline Complexity handling: O(n) time faster than a naive recursive halving A node's minimum left/right subtree width = the horizontal space needed at minimum to hold all its children Layout-strategy options: d3.tree (left-right), d3.cluster (left-right, packed), d3.treemap (area) Theory Patch: The d3-hierarchy Module Family hierarchy(data): convert any nested data into a hierarchy structure (each node gets parent / children / depth) tree().size([h, w]): Reingold-Tilford algorithm, left-right layout cluster().size([h, w]): align all leaf nodes to the same depth treemap().tile(...): area-based (slice-and-dice / squarified / resquarify algorithms) pack().radius(d = ...): circle packing partition().size([h, w]): icicle / sunburst layout Key Code hierarchy + tree in Three Steps This is the standard d3-hierarchy pattern: first build the hierarchy, then compute the tree layout, and finally draw links + nodes.  // 1. hierarchy：从嵌套 JSON → 计算每个节点的 parent/children/depth const root = d3.hierarchy(rootData);  // 2. tree layout：给每个节点算 x/y 坐标 const treeLayout = d3.tree().size([360, 720]); const treeData = treeLayout(root);  // 3. 画 links：父-子连线（Reingold-Tilford 算法结果就在这里） g.selectAll(".link").data(treeData.links()).join("path") .attr("d", d3.linkHorizontal().x(d = d.y).y(d = d.x));  // 4. 画 nodes：圆 + 文字 const ng = g.selectAll(".node").data(treeData.descendants()).join("g") .attr("transform", d = `translate(${d.y}, ${d.x})`); ng.append("circle").attr("r", 5); ng.append("text") .attr("text-anchor", d = d.children ? "end" : "start") .attr("x", d = d.children ? -8 : 8) .text(d = d.data.name); Key explanation: treeData.x is the depth direction (vertical by default), while treeData.y is the horizontal direction (different nodes at the same depth). So linkHorizontal uses x=d.y, y=d.x the horizontal direction rides on y, and the vertical direction rides on x. This x-axis rides on y, y-axis rides on x swap is unique to horizontal trees commit it to memory. Key Code separation Controls Parent-Child Spacing separation accepts a function and returns the spacing multiplier between [node, parent]. const treeLayout = d3.tree() .size([360, 720]) .separation((a, b) = (a.parent === b.parent ? 1 : 2)); // ↑ 兄弟节点紧贴 ↑ 非兄弟至少隔 2 倍 Key explanation: The default value of separation is (a, b) = a.parent === b.parent ? 1 : 2. Change it to 0.5 everything squishes together; change it to 2.0 the tree widens. There is a slider in the demo so you can adjust it in real time and see the effect. Tree Layout Demo Switch aggregation levels (major class / gender major class, etc.) and drag the slider to adjust separation this is visual mapping via the position channel

search.zh: 本节在流程中的位置：视图渲染 + 用户交互 接上节 2.3 视觉映射，我们有了"视觉结构"。本节 2.4 是最后两段箭头： 「视觉结构 → 视图」（渲染） 和 「视图 ↔ 用户」（交互反馈）。 Card 模型的 V 层，加上 van Wijk 的反馈环，都落在这里。 你的原案例 原文档用了 classed 控制节点样式、用 stopPropagation 阻止冒泡。重点是把 D3 树布局输出变成可交互的 HTML 列表。 嵌入理论：DOM 事件三阶段 + 事件委托 浏览器的事件流分三阶段（DOM 规范）： 捕获 (capturing)：window → document → ... → 目标元素（从外到内） 目标 (target)：目标元素本身 冒泡 (bubbling)：目标元素 → ... → document → window（从内到外） 默认监听的是冒泡阶段。你可以在监听器里 e.stopPropagation() 截断冒泡，让上层的监听器不再触发。 理论补丁：动画 —— 视图渲染的"时间维"（van Wijk 反馈的直观体现） 动画（transition）不是"花哨"，而是视图渲染在时间维上的展开。 D3 里用 .transition().duration(ms)， 让属性从旧值平滑过渡到新值。教学价值在 duration 这一个参数： duration=0：瞬间跳变，师生"看不出变化过程" duration=500：0.5 秒过渡，能看到展开/收缩/位移的流畅过程 duration>1500：太慢，学生开始走神 本节的交互 demo 特意加了 duration 滑块， 让你现场改变这个参数，直观看到"渲染如何随时间展开"。这是理解"视图渲染 + 交互反馈"最直接的一课。 理论补丁：事件委托 (Event Delegation) 问题：列表里有 1000 个 li，给每个 li 都绑 click 监听器 → 慢、内存大、新增元素要重新绑。 解法：只给父元素（ul/div）绑 1 个 click 监听器，利用冒泡机制 —— 子元素的 click 最终会触发父元素的监听器。用 e.target.closest('.label') 找到"实际点击的是哪个子元素"。 优势：1 个监听器代替 N 个、未来新增元素自动支持。 关键 API：D3 classed() selection.classed("selected", true); // 1) 添加 class selection.classed("selected", false); // 2) 移除 class selection.classed("selected", d = d.id === pickId); // 3) 函数式批量切换 关键代码 ① 事件委托（一对多监听） 用递归 buildList 构建可折叠树；用 liSel 上的 click 做事件委托，不绑到每个 label。  // 父 ul 上绑一次 click，所有子 li 共享 function buildList(liSel, d) { const label = liSel.append("span").attr("class", "label"); label.on("click.toggle", (event) = { //  关键 ①：阻止冒泡 —— toggle 按钮不该触发"选中" event.stopPropagation(); d.data._collapsed = !d.data._collapsed; render(); }); liSel.on("click.select", (event) = { //  关键 ②：如果 click 来自 toggle，已经被 stopPropagation 阻断，不会到这里 document.querySelectorAll("li").forEach(li = li.classList.remove("selected")); liSel.classed("selected", true); }); } 关键点解释： 这是经典的「阻止 toggle 按钮冒泡到 li 的 select 监听器」模式。如果不 stopPropagation， 点 toggle 时会同时触发"切换折叠"和"选中节点"，用户看着会困惑。 这是 DOM 事件机制的核心教学点。 关键代码 ② 嵌套递归 buildList d3 selection 的递归渲染：每个 li 内部再有 ul/li，再递归 buildList。 function render() { $tree.innerHTML = ""; const ul = d3.create("ul"); ul.selectAll("li").data([root]).join("li") .each(function(d) { buildList(d3.select(this), d); }); $tree.appendChild(ul.node()); } 关键代码 ③ D3 过渡动画（transition + duration） 视图渲染的"时间维"：让节点展开/收缩时平滑过渡，不是瞬间跳变。duration 由滑块实时控制。  // 关键：transition + duration = 让属性随时间平滑变化 svg.selectAll(".node") .transition() // 进入过渡状态 .duration(DURATION) // 时长（ms），滑块控制 .attr("transform", d = `translate(${d.y}, ${d.x})`) .attr("opacity", 1); // 新节点进入时：先设 opacity=0，再过渡到 1 → 淡入效果 ng.attr("opacity", 0) .transition().duration(DURATION).attr("opacity", 1); 关键代码 ④ 动画时长滑块（直接在 HTML/CSS 里控制） !-- HTML 滑块：监听 input 事件即可改 DURATION -- input id="dur" type="range" min="0" max="1500" step="50" value="500" // JS：改变 DURATION 后重放动画 document.getElementById("dur").addEventListener("input", e = { DURATION = +e.target.value; render(); // 用新时长重新做一次过渡 }); 关键点解释： 为什么用 innerHTML = "" 清空再重画？ D3 没有"智能更新"树结构（层级变化）的 API —— 节点展开/折叠会改变父子结构，最简单的做法是全量重新渲染。 用 selection.each() 配合 d3.select(this) 把原生元素转回 selection，这是 D3 与原生 DOM 互操作的关键模式。 ▶ 可折叠树形列表  点击三角形 toggle 折叠/展开 · 点击条目本身选中（看下方日志）· 拖动「动画时长」滑块看 transition 效果
search.en: Where This Sits: View Rendering + User Interaction Following the 2.3 visual mapping, we now have a visual structure. Section 2.4 covers the last two arrows: visual structure view (rendering) and view user (interaction feedback). Card's V layer and van Wijk's feedback loop both land here. Your Original Case The original document used classed to control node styles and stopPropagation to block bubbling. The focus is on turning the D3 tree layout output into an interactive HTML list. Embedded Theory: The Three Phases of DOM Events + Event Delegation The browser's event flow has three phases (per the DOM spec): Capturing: window document ... target element (outside to inside) Target: the target element itself Bubbling: target element ... document window (inside to outside) By default, listeners are registered on the bubbling phase. Inside a listener you can call e.stopPropagation() to cut off bubbling so ancestor listeners no longer fire. Theory Patch: Animation the time dimension of view rendering Animation (transition) isn't fancy it's the time dimension of view rendering. In D3 you use .transition().duration(ms) to smoothly interpolate an attribute from its old value to a new one. The pedagogical value lies in the single duration parameter: duration=0: instant jump you can't see the change happen duration=500: a 0.5 s transition you see the expand / collapse / move smoothly duration>1500: too slow students start to drift This lesson's interactive demo adds a duration slider so you can change this parameter live and see how rendering unfolds over time. It's the most direct lesson on view rendering + interaction feedback. Theory Patch: Event Delegation Problem: if a list has 1000 li elements and you bind a click listener to each it's slow, memory-heavy, and newly added elements have to be re-bound. Solution: bind only 1 click listener on the parent element (ul / div) and lean on bubbling a click on any child eventually triggers the parent's listener. Use e.target.closest('.label') to figure out which child element was actually clicked. Advantage: 1 listener replaces N, and any future newly added elements are automatically supported. Key API: D3 classed() selection.classed("selected", true); // 1) 添加 class selection.classed("selected", false); // 2) 移除 class selection.classed("selected", d = d.id === pickId); // 3) 函数式批量切换 Key Code Event Delegation (one-to-many listening) Use recursive buildList to construct the collapsible tree; use the click on liSel for event delegation rather than binding to each label.  // 父 ul 上绑一次 click，所有子 li 共享 function buildList(liSel, d) { const label = liSel.append("span").attr("class", "label"); label.on("click.toggle", (event) = { //  关键 ①：阻止冒泡 —— toggle 按钮不该触发"选中" event.stopPropagation(); d.data._collapsed = !d.data._collapsed; render(); }); liSel.on("click.select", (event) = { //  关键 ②：如果 click 来自 toggle，已经被 stopPropagation 阻断，不会到这里 document.querySelectorAll("li").forEach(li = li.classList.remove("selected")); liSel.classed("selected", true); }); } Key explanation: This is the classic pattern of stopping the toggle button from bubbling up to the li's select listener. Without stopPropagation, clicking the toggle would simultaneously trigger toggle collapse and select the node, which would confuse users. This is a core teaching point about the DOM event mechanism. Key Code Nested Recursive buildList Recursive rendering with d3 selections: every li contains another ul/li, then buildList recurses into it. function render() { $tree.innerHTML = ""; const ul = d3.create("ul"); ul.selectAll("li").data([root]).join("li") .each(function(d) { buildList(d3.select(this), d); }); $tree.appendChild(ul.node()); } Key Code D3 Transition (transition + duration) The time dimension of view rendering: smoothly interpolate node expand / collapse instead of an instant jump. duration is controlled by a live slider.  // 关键：transition + duration = 让属性随时间平滑变化 svg.selectAll(".node") .transition() // 进入过渡状态 .duration(DURATION) // 时长（ms），滑块控制 .attr("transform", d = `translate(${d.y}, ${d.x})`) .attr("opacity", 1); // 新节点进入时：先设 opacity=0，再过渡到 1 → 淡入效果 ng.attr("opacity", 0) .transition().duration(DURATION).attr("opacity", 1); Key Code Animation Duration Slider !-- HTML 滑块：监听 input 事件即可改 DURATION -- input id="dur" type="range" min="0" max="1500" step="50" value="500" // JS：改变 DURATION 后重放动画 document.getElementById("dur").addEventListener("input", e = { DURATION = +e.target.value; render(); // 用新时长重新做一次过渡 }); Key explanation: Why use innerHTML = "" to clear and redraw? D3 has no smart-update API for tree structures (where hierarchy changes) expanding or collapsing a node changes the parent-child structure, and the simplest approach is a full re-render. Use selection.each() together with d3.select(this) to convert the raw element back into a selection this is the key pattern for D3-native-DOM interop. subtitle.zh: 为什么需要 4 种颜色空间？它们各自擅长什么？色盲眼中看到的世界是怎样的？
subtitle.en: Why do we need 4 color spaces? What is each one good at? What does the world look like through the eyes of someone with color blindness?

search.zh: 为什么要学颜色模型？ 设计 colormap 时，不能直接用 RGB 插值——因为 RGB 不是感知均匀的（255,0,0 与 0,255,0 "看上去"亮度差很多）。你需要感知均匀的颜色空间（Lab / HCL）来插值，才能得到平滑的渐变。 4 大颜色空间 RGB：加色模型，设备相关。屏幕显示的默认。 HSL：艺术家友好（色相/饱和度/亮度独立），但仍不感知均匀。 CIE Lab：感知均匀，设计 colormap 的黄金标准。 CMYK：减色（印刷），web 可视化用不到。 CVD（色觉缺陷） 约 8% 男性、0.5% 女性是色盲。常见三种： 红色盲（protanopia）：约 1% 男性 绿色盲（deuteranopia）：约 6% 男性（最常见） 蓝色盲（tritanopia）：极罕见  关键代码  关键点 1：RGB → HSL 手写 function rgbToHsl(r, g, b) { r /= 255; g /= 255; b /= 255; const max = Math.max(r, g, b), min = Math.min(r, g, b); let h, s, l = (max + min) / 2; if (max === min) { h = s = 0; } else { const d = max - min; s = l 0.5 ? d / (2 - max - min) : d / (max + min); switch (max) { case r: h = (g - b) / d + (g b ? 6 : 0); break; case g: h = (b - r) / d + 2; break; case b: h = (r - g) / d + 4; break; } h /= 6; } return [h * 360, s * 100, l * 100]; }  自己写 RGB↔HSL 是为了理解每一步的物理含义——"最大通道决定色相、相减决定饱和度"——比用 d3 库更能理解色相为什么在 0-360° 循环。  关键点 2：CVD 模拟矩阵 const CVD_MATRICES = { deuteranopia: [ [0.625, 0.375, 0.000], [0.700, 0.300, 0.000], [0.000, 0.300, 0.700] ], protanopia: [[0.567, 0.433, 0.000], [0.558, 0.442, 0.000], [0.000, 0.242, 0.758]], tritanopia: [[0.950, 0.050, 0.000], [0.000, 0.433, 0.567], [0.000, 0.475, 0.525]] }; function simulateCVD([r, g, b], type) { const m = CVD_MATRICES[type]; return [ r * m[0][0] + g * m[0][1] + b * m[0][2], r * m[1][0] + g * m[1][1] + b * m[1][2], r * m[2][0] + g * m[2][1] + b * m[2][2] ].map(v = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(255, v)))); }  关键点 3：d3 内置多空间 const c = d3.color('rgb(100, 50, 200)'); c.rgb(); // {r, g, b} c.hsl(); // {h, s, l} c.lab(); // {l, a, b} ← 感知均匀 c.hcl(); // {h, c, l} ← Lab 极坐标版 加载中…
search.en: Why learn color models? When designing a colormap, do not interpolate directly in RGB—because RGB is not perceptually uniform (255,0,0 and 0,255,0 "look" very different in lightness). You need a perceptually uniform color space (Lab / HCL) to interpolate and get smooth gradients. The 4 major color spaces RGB: additive model, device-dependent. The default for screen display. HSL: artist-friendly (independent hue / saturation / lightness), but still not perceptually uniform. CIE Lab: perceptually uniform, the gold standard for designing colormaps. CMYK: subtractive (print). Not used in web visualizations. CVD (Color Vision Deficiency) About 8% of men and 0.5% of women are color-blind. Three common types: Protanopia (red-blind): ~1% of men Deuteranopia (green-blind): ~6% of men (most common) Tritanopia (blue-blind): extremely rare  Key code  Key point 1: Hand-written RGB ↔ HSL function rgbToHsl(r, g, b) { r /= 255; g /= 255; b /= 255; const max = Math.max(r, g, b), min = Math.min(r, g, b); let h, s, l = (max + min) / 2; if (max === min) { h = s = 0; } else { const d = max - min; s = l 0.5 ? d / (2 - max - min) : d / (max + min); switch (max) { case r: h = (g - b) / d + (g b ? 6 : 0); break; case g: h = (b - r) / d + 2; break; case b: h = (r - g) / d + 4; break; } h /= 6; } return [h * 360, s * 100, l * 100]; }  Writing RGB↔HSL yourself is to understand the physical meaning of each step—"the largest channel determines hue, the difference determines saturation"—which is more illuminating than using a d3 library for understanding why hue cycles between 0–360°.  Key point 2: CVD simulation matrix const CVD_MATRICES = { deuteranopia: [ [0.625, 0.375, 0.000], [0.700, 0.300, 0.000], [0.000, 0.300, 0.700] ], protanopia: [[0.567, 0.433, 0.000], [0.558, 0.442, 0.000], [0.000, 0.242, 0.758]], tritanopia: [[0.950, 0.050, 0.000], [0.000, 0.433, 0.567], [0.000, 0.475, 0.525]] }; function simulateCVD([r, g, b], type) { const m = CVD_MATRICES[type]; return [ r * m[0][0] + g * m[0][1] + b * m[0][2], r * m[1][0] + g * m[1][1] + b * m[1][2], r * m[2][0] + g * m[2][1] + b * m[2][2] ].map(v = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(255, v)))); }  Key point 3: d3's built-in multi-space support const c = d3.color('rgb(100, 50, 200)'); c.rgb(); // {r, g, b} c.hsl(); // {h, s, l} c.lab(); // {l, a, b} ← 感知均匀 c.hcl(); // {h, c, l} ← Lab 极坐标版 加载中…

subtitle.zh: 顺序型 / 发散型 / 定性型。选错类型 = 误导读者。
subtitle.en: Sequential / Diverging / Qualitative. Choosing the wrong type = misleading your readers.

outline.zh: 三类 colormap 对应不同数据语义

outline.en: Three colormap families match three data semantics

search.zh: 三类 colormap 对应不同数据语义 顺序型（Sequential）：数据有自然顺序（人口、温度）。单调亮度 + 单调色相。例子：Viridis / Plasma / Cividis 发散型（Diverging）：数据有意义的"中点"（如 0、正负偏差、白人中位数）。两端异色，中间白/浅。例子：RdBu / BrBG / PiYG 定性型（Qualitative）：数据无序（如产品类别）。色相区分、亮度接近。例子：Tableau10 / Set1 / Set3 典型错误 用发散型 RdBu 画"50 州谋杀率"（有序数据）——中段接近白色，看上去"谋杀率 = 100 附近"的州是"中点"——但 100 没有任何语义，纯属误导。 CVD 友好检查清单 Viridis / Cividis：✓ 优（Nature Methods 推荐） RdBu / BrBG：△ 中等（红绿对色盲不友好） Tableau10（定性）：△ 与色相相关 Jet（彩虹谱）：△ 禁用  关键代码  关键点 1：d3 三类 scale 速记 // 顺序型：[0, 1] → 颜色 d3.scaleSequential(d3.interpolateViridis); // 发散型：[0, 1] → 颜色（带中点反转） d3.interpolateRdBu; // t=0 蓝，t=1 红，t=0.5 白 d3.interpolateBrBG; // 定性型：离散类别 → 颜色 d3.scaleOrdinal(d3.schemeTableau10);  选错类型 = "撒谎"。比如用 Viridis 表示正负偏差，用户会以为"中点 = 白色"——但 Viridis 的中点是深紫色。  关键点 2：决策表 function pickColormap(data) { if (data.hasMeaningfulMidpoint) return 'diverging'; if (data.isOrdered) return 'sequential'; return 'categorical'; } 加载中…
search.en: Three colormap families match three data semantics Sequential: data with a natural order (population, temperature). Monotonic lightness + monotonic hue. Examples: Viridis / Plasma / Cividis Diverging: data with a meaningful "midpoint" (e.g., zero, signed deviation, white median). Different hues at the two ends, white/light in the middle. Examples: RdBu / BrBG / PiYG Qualitative: unordered data (e.g., product categories). Distinct hues, similar lightness. Examples: Tableau10 / Set1 / Set3 Common mistakes Using the diverging palette RdBu for "murder rates in 50 states" (ordinal data)—the middle band looks near-white, so states with a murder rate "around 100" appear to be the "midpoint"—but 100 has no semantic meaning, so this is purely misleading. CVD-friendly checklist Viridis / Cividis: ✓ excellent (recommended by Nature Methods) RdBu / BrBG: △ moderate (red-green pairs are not CVD-friendly) Tableau10 (qualitative): △ hue-related issues Jet (rainbow): △ do not use  Key code  Key point 1: d3's three scale families at a glance // 顺序型：[0, 1] → 颜色 d3.scaleSequential(d3.interpolateViridis); // 发散型：[0, 1] → 颜色（带中点反转） d3.interpolateRdBu; // t=0 蓝，t=1 红，t=0.5 白 d3.interpolateBrBG; // 定性型：离散类别 → 颜色 d3.scaleOrdinal(d3.schemeTableau10);  Choosing the wrong type = "lying". For example, using Viridis for signed deviations makes users assume "the midpoint is white" — but Viridis's midpoint is dark purple.  Key point 2: Decision table function pickColormap(data) { if (data.hasMeaningfulMidpoint) return 'diverging'; if (data.isOrdered) return 'sequential'; return 'categorical'; } 加载中…

subtitle.zh: 在感知均匀的颜色空间里，色域长什么样？
subtitle.en: What does the gamut look like inside a perceptually uniform color space?

outline.zh: 为什么需要 Lab 色域图？

outline.en: Why do we need a Lab gamut diagram?

search.zh: 为什么需要 Lab 色域图？ RGB 空间是立方体，但你不知道"哪些颜色真的存在、哪些会失真"。CIE Lab 是感知均匀空间，距离 ≈ 人眼感知差，是设计 colormap 和检查色域的标准。 三个色域（嵌套关系） sRGB：屏幕通用标准（Web/PPT/一般科研图） Adobe RGB：摄影/印刷，绿域更广 Rec.2020：4K 电视/HDR，色域最大 超出 sRGB 的颜色（如高饱和度的纯绿）在普通屏幕上显示不出来，会被 clamp。 实战用法 从 d3.lab(L, a, b).rgb() 转换时，超出 sRGB 的颜色会自动 clamp 设计 colormap 时用 d3.interpolateLab（在 Lab 空间插值），比 d3.interpolateRgb 平滑得多 高饱和度色仅在打印/4K 屏幕上"存在"，Web 上看不一定准确  关键代码  关键点 1：Lab 颜色对象 // 直接构造 Lab 颜色 const c = d3.lab(50, 30, -20); // L*=50, a*=30, b*=-20 console.log(c.rgb()); // → RGB {r, g, b}（clamp 到 sRGB） console.log(c.formatHex()); // → "#xxxxxx" // 从 RGB 反向构造 const c2 = d3.color('#ff0080'); console.log(c2.lab()); // → {l, a, b}  d3.lab() 返回的是 Lab 颜色对象，但显示时还是转回 RGB。Lab 是"思考空间"，RGB 是"显示空间"。  关键点 2：在 Lab 空间插值 // 在 Lab 空间插值（感知均匀） const interp = d3.interpolateLab('#000000', '#ffffff'); interp(0.5); // → 中间灰（Lab 空间线性插值，结果感知均匀） // vs 在 RGB 空间插值（不均匀） const interpRgb = d3.interpolateRgb('#000000', '#ffffff'); interpRgb(0.5); // → 中间灰（RGB 空间插值，但在 Lab 看来"不是中间"） 加载中…
search.en: Why do we need a Lab gamut diagram? RGB space is a cube, but you cannot tell "which colors actually exist and which would be distorted". CIE Lab is a perceptually uniform space, distance ≈ perceived difference, and is the standard for designing colormaps and checking gamut. Three gamuts (nested relationship) sRGB: universal screen standard (Web / PPT / general scientific figures) Adobe RGB: photography / print, wider green gamut Rec.2020: 4K TV / HDR, the largest gamut Colors outside sRGB (e.g., highly saturated pure green) cannot be displayed on ordinary screens and get clamped. Practical usage When converting from d3.lab(L, a, b).rgb(), colors outside sRGB are clamped automatically When designing colormaps, use d3.interpolateLab (interpolates in Lab space), which is far smoother than d3.interpolateRgb Highly saturated colors only "exist" on print / 4K screens, and may not look accurate on the Web  Key code  Key point 1: Lab color object // 直接构造 Lab 颜色 const c = d3.lab(50, 30, -20); // L*=50, a*=30, b*=-20 console.log(c.rgb()); // → RGB {r, g, b}（clamp 到 sRGB） console.log(c.formatHex()); // → "#xxxxxx" // 从 RGB 反向构造 const c2 = d3.color('#ff0080'); console.log(c2.lab()); // → {l, a, b}  d3.lab() returns a Lab color object, but when displaying you still convert back to RGB. Lab is the "thinking space", RGB is the "display space".  Key point 2: Interpolate in Lab space // 在 Lab 空间插值（感知均匀） const interp = d3.interpolateLab('#000000', '#ffffff'); interp(0.5); // → 中间灰（Lab 空间线性插值，结果感知均匀） // vs 在 RGB 空间插值（不均匀） const interpRgb = d3.interpolateRgb('#000000', '#ffffff'); interpRgb(0.5); // → 中间灰（RGB 空间插值，但在 Lab 看来"不是中间"） 加载中…

title.zh: 3.4 色系搭配规则（5 大类）

subtitle.zh: 单色 / 类比 / 互补 / 三等分 / 分裂互补——什么时候用哪个？
subtitle.en: Monochromatic / Analogous / Complementary / Triadic / Split-Complementary—when do you use each?

search.zh: 5 大色系规则 单色 Monochromatic：同一色相不同亮度/饱和。安全、低风险。 类比 Analogous：色轮相邻 ±30°。和谐但缺少对比度。 互补 Complementary：色轮正对面 180°。对比度强但易刺眼。 三等分 Triadic：色轮 120° 等分。3 种类别时最常用。 分裂互补 Split：互补色相邻 150°。温和版互补。 选择原则 严肃科研：单色（Nature 黑白经济型配色） 层级 / 分组：类比 突出重点：互补（实验组 vs 对照组） 3 种类别：三等分 一般情况：分裂互补（不刺眼又有对比）  关键代码  关键点 1：HSL 色相差 // 5 大色系的"色相差"参数 const HUE_OFFSETS = { monochromatic: 0, // 同色相 analogous: 30, // ±30° complementary: 180, // 180° 对面 triadic: 120, // 120° 三等分 split: 150 // 150° 邻补 }; // 生成 5 色调色板 function palette(baseH, offset) { return [-2, -1, 0, 1, 2].map(i = { const h = (baseH + i * offset + 360) % 360; return d3.hsl(h, 0.6, 0.55).formatHex(); }); }  d3.hsl(h, s, l) 直接构造 HSL 颜色对象。HSL 中 H 是 0-360° 循环，相加要 mod 360。 加载中…
search.en: The 5 major color scheme rules Monochromatic: the same hue with varying lightness / saturation. Safe and low risk. Analogous: adjacent on the color wheel, within ±30°. Harmonious but lacking contrast. Complementary: directly opposite on the color wheel at 180°. Strong contrast but can be jarring. Triadic: evenly spaced at 120° on the color wheel. The most common choice for 3 categories. Split-Complementary: adjacent to the complement at 150°. A softer version of complementary. Selection principles Serious scientific work: monochromatic (Nature-style black-and-white economical palette) Hierarchy / grouping: analogous Highlight a focal point: complementary (treatment vs control) 3 categories: triadic General cases: split-complementary (not jarring, but still has contrast)  Key code  Key point 1: HSL hue difference // 5 大色系的"色相差"参数 const HUE_OFFSETS = { monochromatic: 0, // 同色相 analogous: 30, // ±30° complementary: 180, // 180° 对面 triadic: 120, // 120° 三等分 split: 150 // 150° 邻补 }; // 生成 5 色调色板 function palette(baseH, offset) { return [-2, -1, 0, 1, 2].map(i = { const h = (baseH + i * offset + 360) % 360; return d3.hsl(h, 0.6, 0.55).formatHex(); }); }  d3.hsl(h, s, l) directly constructs an HSL color object. In HSL, H cycles through 0–360°, so additions must be mod 360. 加载中…

subtitle.zh: Wong / Paul Tol / Okabe-Ito / Tableau / Paired / Viridis——顶标都在用什么？
subtitle.en: Wong / Paul Tol / Okabe-Ito / Tableau / Paired / Viridis—what are top journals using?

search.zh: 3 大黄金标准 Wong 2011：Nature Methods 8:441 推荐，8 色 CVD 友好，灰度打印友好 Paul Tol：SRON Tech Note，bright（白底）/ muted（深底）/ high-contrast（对比 Okabe-Ito 2002：8 色，CVD 友好，早期 Nature/Science 默认 商业 / 通用 Tableau 10：商业图表之王，10 色，红绿对色盲不友好 Paired (12)：配对设计（处理前/后），12 色过载 顺序型 / 发散型 Viridis：matplotlib/d3 默认，感知均匀 + CVD 友好 Cividid：Viridis 的 CVD 强化版（更蓝/黄分明） RdBu：发散型红蓝 实战原则 类别数 ≤ 7，类别多时改用连续 colormap 必须经过 CVD 模拟测试 优先使用 CVD 友好 + 灰度友好的（顶标都用这套）  关键代码  关键点 1：经典配色硬编码数组 const CLASSIC_PALETTES = { 'Wong 2011': ['#000000', '#E69F00', '#56B4E9', '#009E73', '#F0E442', '#0072B2', '#D55E00', '#CC79A7'], 'Paul Tol bright': ['#4477AA', '#EE6677', '#228833', '#CCBB44', '#66CCEE', '#AA3377', '#BBBBBB'], 'Okabe-Ito': ['#000000', '#E69F00', '#56B4E9', '#009E73', '#F0E442', '#0072B2', '#D55E00', '#CC79A7'], 'Tableau 10': ['#4E79A7', '#F28E2B', '#E15759', '#76B7B2', '#59A14F', '#EDC948', '#B07AA1', '#FF9DA7', '#9C755F', '#BAB0AC'], 'Viridis (seq)': d3.range(0, 1.01, 0.1).map(d3.interpolateViridis), 'RdBu (div)': d3.range(0, 1.01, 0.1).map(t = d3.interpolateRdBu(1 - t)) };  直接用 hex 数组硬编码比用 d3 内置 scheme 更稳——因为 scheme 名字在不同 d3 版本会变。 加载中…
search.en: The 3 gold standards Wong 2011: recommended in Nature Methods 8:441, 8-color, CVD-friendly and grayscale-print-friendly Paul Tol: SRON Tech Note, bright (on white background) / muted (on dark background) / high-contrast Okabe-Ito 2002: 8 colors, CVD-friendly, the default in early Nature/Science Commercial / general purpose Tableau 10: the king of commercial charts, 10 colors, red-green pairs are not CVD-friendly Paired (12): paired designs (pre/post), 12 colors are too many Sequential / Diverging Viridis: default in matplotlib / d3, perceptually uniform + CVD-friendly Cividis: a CVD-reinforced version of Viridis (more distinct blue/yellow) RdBu: diverging red-blue Practical principles If the number of categories ≤ 7; for more categories, switch to a continuous colormap Must pass CVD simulation testing Prefer CVD-friendly + grayscale-friendly palettes (this is what top journals use)  Key code  Key point 1: Hard-coding classic palettes as arrays const CLASSIC_PALETTES = { 'Wong 2011': ['#000000', '#E69F00', '#56B4E9', '#009E73', '#F0E442', '#0072B2', '#D55E00', '#CC79A7'], 'Paul Tol bright': ['#4477AA', '#EE6677', '#228833', '#CCBB44', '#66CCEE', '#AA3377', '#BBBBBB'], 'Okabe-Ito': ['#000000', '#E69F00', '#56B4E9', '#009E73', '#F0E442', '#0072B2', '#D55E00', '#CC79A7'], 'Tableau 10': ['#4E79A7', '#F28E2B', '#E15759', '#76B7B2', '#59A14F', '#EDC948', '#B07AA1', '#FF9DA7', '#9C755F', '#BAB0AC'], 'Viridis (seq)': d3.range(0, 1.01, 0.1).map(d3.interpolateViridis), 'RdBu (div)': d3.range(0, 1.01, 0.1).map(t = d3.interpolateRdBu(1 - t)) };  Hard-coding as hex arrays is more stable than using d3's built-in schemes—because scheme names change across d3 versions. 加载中…
